resources.string: Twig here, photo edition! Every picture is a little tattletale: where you stood, when, which phone, sometimes even a tiny copy of the shot BEFORE you cropped it. Hand me some photos and I\'ll make them forget all that. Not one pixel changes, and nothing leaves your phone. I don\'t even HAVE internet.
Strips hidden photo metadata: GPS, time, phone model, serial numbers, owner names, thumbnails, edit history, motion-photo videos. Lossless: the picture itself is never re-encoded.
